title: Unable to properly set custom Window.Location past hardcoded value - Lacks UW support / Multi Monitor
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduceable in Godot 4.5
Not reproduceable in Godot 4.4.1

Not tested in any other versions

### System information

Godot v4.5.rc2.mono - cpe:/o:nixos:nixos:25.05 #1-NixOS SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu Sep 11 15:21:47 UTC 2025 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (nvidia; 570.153.02) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 46.95 GiB memory

### Issue description

Custom popup window for a plugin
When manually setting X position, if the value exceeds 1920 + windowWidth /2, then the visible coordinates of popup window reset to 0, however the actual printed coordinates still state window is at xpos 1920

Increasing the window xpos past 1920 moves window towards right, with respect to 1920 offset
Ex:
windowXpos = 1919, window gets created on correct monitor at appropriate location
windowXpos = 1920, window gets created at xpos 0
windowXpos = 1921, window gets created at xpos 1
windowXpos = 3840+, window gets created at xpos 1920+

### Steps to reproduce

Setup:
- Multi monitor setup, 1920x1080 on left, 3440x1440 on right 

Reproduce:
- Create a custom popup window in editor
- Manually set it's position to 1920 - half window width
- Window X visible cords will rollback to 0
- Keep increasing window position (x)  arbitrarily, and window moves as expected as long as 1920 offset is accounted for
